rules: Intentional source-to-project mirrors are not independent research.
Shared publication URLs retain distinct source IDs, locators, dates and scopes.
Website narrative and research record describe one entity but have different editorial responsibilities.
Anthology and component story counts cannot be summed as independent books.
Do not merge observations using only matching numbers; scope, vintage, price basis and estimate/project status matter.
Archive historical duplicates; do not delete unique evidence or rewrite published narrative.
limitations: Only exact within-atlas duplicate observations tested; equivalent metrics across separate datasets need explicit mapping and scope review.
Broad title similarity is discovery, not proven identity.
Project snapshot excludes concurrent uncommitted visitor-experience work.
Local duplicate-named untracked files in the earlier review clone are excluded from committed counts and left untouched.
